title: YouTube will expand Premium Lite availability, increase requirements for revenue sharing
description: The YouTube Partner Program (YPP) launched two decades ago and now boasts over 3 million creators. However, if you want to join their ranks, you will now have to meet higher requirements than before. That said, if you are already in YPP, you will stay in YPP. For those looking to join, you will need to hit double the metrics of the previous thresholds. For long-form videos, this means 8,000 view hours, up from 4,000 hours. title: FDA approves Samsung's Hearing Aid feature on Galaxy Buds
description: Samsung has been improving its health-tracking features and the recent FDA approval for the Galaxy Buds' Hearing Aid feature adds another such feature to its toolbox. The US Food and Drug Administration cleared the Hearing Aid feature as an over-the-counter (OTC) solution for users aged 18 and above. It makes some Galaxy Buds models a convenient alternative to some expensive hearing aid devices for people with mild to moderate hearing loss. title: The smartphone market dropped by 7% in Q2 because of rising memory prices
description: According to an FDM CCS Insight report, global smartphone shipments declined by 7% in Q2, compared to Q2 of 2025. They fell 3% in comparison to Q1 of this year. Overall, FDM forecasts a 12% decline in global smartphone shipments in 2026. Developed markets like Europe and North America declined only by low single digits, while emerging markets, whose buyers are more sensitive to price increases, saw larger declines.
